{{Quote|Thought you could hide in the swamps? Pathetic!|Draynon Atrus to the Outlander|<ref name="Chapter 5" />}}
'''Draynon Atrus''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served as a [[Knight-Captain]] in the [[Knights of Zakuul]], an order of [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] warriors who protected the [[Eternal Empire]] and its ruler, the Immortal Emperor.<ref name="Chapter 5" /> In [[3631 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> he was a leader of the Zakuulan forces that attempted to recapture the recently freed criminal known as [[Alliance Commander|the Outlander]] on [[Zakuul]]. Atrus was [[Death/Legends|killed]] in the fighting.<ref name="Chapter 5" />

==Behind the scenes==
Draynon Atrus was added to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as part of the Digital Expansion [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire|''Knights of the Fallen Empire'']], where he first appeared in Chapter 5: From the Grave.
